items.title: 31.7 Energy density aur specific energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of energy density and specific energy (PDF 228).

blocks.text: Kisi kaam ke liye fuel chunte waqt do ahem miqdarein dekhi jati hain: energy density aur specific energy.

blocks.title: Energy density
blocks.text: Energy density kisi maddah ki tawanai ki gunjaish hai, jo aam taur par fuel ke fi ikai hajm (volume) mein jama ho sakne wali tawanai ki miqdar ke taur par, aksar megajoules fi litre (MJ/L) mein, bayan hoti hai.

Zyada energy density wale fuels nisbatan chhote hajm mein zyada tawanai jama karte hain. Kitab in ka istemal saakin (stationary) kaamon aur zakhire, jaise bijli ghar aur generators, mein batati hai. Maslan diesel (taqreeban 35.8 MJ/L) ki energy density gasoline (taqreeban 34.2 MJ/L) se zyada hai: is ke fi litre mein zyada tawanai hai.

blocks.title: Specific energy
blocks.text: Specific energy kisi maddah ki fi ikai kamiyat (mass) mein mojood tawanai ki miqdar hai. Yeh aam taur par megajoules fi kilogram (MJ/kg) mein napi jati hai.

Specific energy tab ahem hai jab wazan nazuk ho, jaise hawai jahazon aur khalai jahazon mein. Zyada specific energy wala fuel zyada wazan barhaye baghair bohat tawanai deta hai. Maslan hydrogen gas ki specific energy bohat zyada (120 MJ/kg) hai, jo ise khalai sanat ke liye dilchasp banati hai, agarche is ki energy density kam hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat: CNG
blocks.text: Pakistan mein naql-o-hamal mein use hone wali compressed natural gas (CNG) bohat kifayati hai, lekin is ki energy density petrol se kam hai, is liye gariyon ko kafi fuel ke liye zyada hajm ka zakhira uthana parta hai. Isi liye CNG maqami aamad-o-raft ke liye munasib hai aur lambe safar ke liye mauzoon nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen: fi litre tawanai ka bar chart: diesel taqreeban 35.8 MJ/L aur gasoline taqreeban 34.2 MJ/L. Daen: hydrogen gas taqreeban 120 MJ/kg, bohat zyada specific energy jo wazan ahem hone par mufeed lekin energy density kam; CNG ki energy density petrol se kam, jo chhote petrol tank ke saath bohat bare CNG cylinder se dikhayi gayi (khaaka, paimane par nahi).
blocks.caption: Energy density aur specific energy (topic 31.7 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Energy density fuels ka hajm se muqabla karti hai (tank kitna bara ho); specific energy kamiyat se (fuel kitna bhari ho). Fuel aik paimane par achha aur doosre par kamzor ho sakta hai, jaise hydrogen.

blocks.prompt: 50 L diesel ke tank mein, aur 50 L gasoline mein, taqreeban kitni tawanai jama hai?
blocks.explanation: Diesel: 50 x 35.8 = taqreeban 1790 MJ; gasoline: 50 x 34.2 = taqreeban 1710 MJ.

blocks.prompt: Khalai jahaz ke liye zyada energy density wala fuel dekhenge ya zyada specific energy wala? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Zyada specific energy, kyunke wazan nazuk hai: fuel zyada wazan barhaye baghair bohat tawanai de.

items: Energy density: fi hajm tawanai (MJ/L); diesel 35.8 > gasoline 34.2.
Specific energy: fi kamiyat tawanai (MJ/kg); hydrogen 120.
CNG: kam energy density, maqami safar ke liye munasib.
